notes.title: Meptik Haunted House 1.12 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Gameplay


 Swapped the controls for turning and movement to be consistent with other VR titles
 Sprinting is now bound to the lower face button on the right controller as a result of the above change
 UI Interactions are now bound to the right trigger to be consistent with other VR titles


UI

 Resized the elements in the elements in the main menu to be consistent.
 Reposition the text in the settings menu to be more visual correct


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you couldn't toggle between the different sections of the Settings Menu


Developer Comments
This patch is meant to be a small quality of life update and make the game's controls feel more consistent with other VR titles. I hope these controls feel better for everyone who downloads and know that I plan on doing more to improve them in the distant future!

Thank you to everyone who played and left a review!
